title: Felt the Virgin Mary's presence and guidance in Portugal

tellings.quote: related. This plus my encounter I'd had with her in Portugal, where I hadn't met her, but I felt her mind and thoughts.

plain: A former senior CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says that in Portugal in 1998 he felt the presence of the Virgin Mary. He tells Michels he had not met her there, but he could feel her mind and thoughts, and he links that moment to a later experience of hers that he describes. If true, it would mean a seasoned intelligence officer believes he was personally guided by a holy figure.
